appError.title.context: Heading of the full-screen error state

appError.body.context: Explanation under the error heading; suggest what to do, never alarm

language.choose.context: Onboarding title above the four language cards

newUpdates.context: Badge text next to a masjid: number of unseen posts (ICU plural)

countdown.hoursMinutes.context: Time left until the next jamaat, e.g. "2h 18m left". Footnote line on the masjid card (06 footnote style), not a fixed-width pill

countdown.minutes.context: Time left when under an hour, e.g. "48m left"

home.greeting.context: Greeting above the masjid list on Home (Islamic greeting, as in the reference design)

nav.back.context: Accessible name of the back chevron button

nav.close.context: Accessible name of the close (X) button on full-screen modals

tabs.label.context: Screen-reader name of the bottom tab bar landmark

tabs.home.context: Tab bar label (micro text, very short)

tabs.myMasjids.context: Tab bar label (micro text, very short)

tabs.scan.context: Accessible name of the round Scan button in the tab bar

tabs.updates.context: Tab bar label (micro text, very short)

tabs.settings.context: Tab bar label (micro text, very short)

placeholder.comingSoon.context: Phase 0 placeholder body on not-yet-built screens

placeholder.openNext.context: Phase 0 placeholder button that opens another screen (navigation test)

placeholder.scanTitle.context: Title of the Scan screen placeholder

ui.seeAll.context: Link-button at the end of a section title (e.g. 'Recent Updates … See All')

ui.verified.context: Small badge next to a masjid name: the masjid was verified by the app team

ui.newCount.context: Screen-reader name of the red number badge on a row (count of unseen items, ICU plural)

ui.optional.context: Small grey word after a form field label: the field may be left empty

ui.characterCount.context: Screen-reader text for the character counter under a text box (visually shown as '120/500')

ui.clearSearch.context: Accessible name of the X button inside the search box

ui.cancel.context: Button that closes a confirm dialog without doing anything

ui.dismiss.context: Accessible name of the X that closes a message bar at the top

ui.choose.context: Placeholder in a pick-list field when nothing is chosen yet

ui.previousMonth.context: Accessible name of the left arrow in the calendar

ui.nextMonth.context: Accessible name of the right arrow in the calendar

ui.hour.context: Accessible name of the hour wheel in the time picker

ui.minute.context: Accessible name of the minute wheel in the time picker

ui.period.context: Accessible name of the AM/PM wheel in the time picker

ui.deleteDigit.context: Accessible name of the backspace key on the amount keypad

ui.offline.context: Thin banner at the top when the phone has no internet; the app still shows cached timings

ui.updateAvailable.context: Message bar shown when an app update has downloaded

ui.refresh.context: Button on the update message bar that reloads into the new version

ui.install.title.context: Title of the card offering to install the app on Android ({app} = app name)

ui.install.body.context: Why to install, under the install card title

ui.install.action.context: Main button of the install card

ui.notNow.context: Secondary button that skips an optional step

ui.iosInstall.title.context: Title of the 3-step guide for iPhone Safari users ({app} = app name)

ui.iosInstall.share.context: Step 1 of the iPhone install guide (the square-with-arrow icon)

ui.iosInstall.add.context: Step 2 of the iPhone install guide; quote the iOS menu item as iOS shows it in that language

ui.iosInstall.open.context: Step 3 of the iPhone install guide ({app} = app name)

hijri.date.context: Hijri date line on Home and Prayer Timings, e.g. "16 Rabi’ al-Akhir 1448". {day} and {year} are Latin digits, {month} is one of hijri.months.*. Reorder freely for the language.

hijri.afterMaghrib.context: Small note after the Hijri date in the evening: the Hijri day has already advanced at sunset

hijri.months.m1.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 1 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m2.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 2 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m3.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 3 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m4.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 4 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m5.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 5 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m6.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 6 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m7.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 7 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m8.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 8 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m9.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 9 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m10.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 10 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m11.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 11 as commonly written in India

hijri.months.m12.context: Name of Hijri (Islamic calendar) month 12 as commonly written in India
